body.name: Selected-subgraph graphical replacement
body.construction:
Fix \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), put \(A=A(\eta)\), and let \(B\) be an admissible directed graph on \(A\). For each \(x\in A\) and each \(xy\in E(H[A])\), choose mutually distinct fresh selection labels \(s_x\) and \(s_{xy}=s_{yx}\), none belonging to \(S_\eta\), and define
\[
 \widetilde S
 :=S_\eta\,\dot\cup\,\{s_x:x\in A\}
       \,\dot\cup\,\{s_{xy}:xy\in E(H[A])\}.
\]
Define the basal DAG \(\widetilde G_0\) on \(V\dot\cup\widetilde S\) by
\[
\begin{split}
 E(\widetilde G_0):={}&
 \bigl(E(G_0(\eta))\setminus E(G_0(\eta)[A])\bigr)
 \cup E(B)\\
 &\cup\{x\to s_x:x\in A\}
 \cup\{x\to s_{xy},\ y\to s_{xy}:xy\in E(H[A])\}.
\end{split}
\]
For each \(k\in[K]\), retain every exterior direct target in \(T_k(\eta)\setminus A\). Inside \(A\), let \(\widetilde T_k\cap A\) consist exactly of those \(v\in Z_k\cap A\) that are not proper descendants in \(\widetilde G_0\) of another vertex of \(Z_k\cap A\) or of a retained target in \(T_k(\eta)\setminus A\). Set
\[
 \widetilde T_k
 :=\bigl(T_k(\eta)\setminus A\bigr)\cup(\widetilde T_k\cap A),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)
 :=\bigl(\widetilde S,\widetilde G_0,(\widetilde T_k)_{k=1}^{K}\bigr).
\]
This is a purely graphical selection-set, DAG, and target specification. It supplies neither probability kernels nor a law-level replacement model.
